assessments.reasoning: The official Clojure 1.12.0 JVM core source at lines 2362–2372 documents an atomic replacement computed from the current atom value and multiple possible invocations of the update function. The arities delegate to JVM IAtom.swap. Independently retrieved the exact publisher locator and matched SHA-256 bce3e81261ac1dbfdcdeb75a42e847dcc14a6ea3bd817c17aeb6d031d10bdaf2.

challenge.method: Inspect the same commit's src/jvm/clojure/lang/Atom.java lines 31–86 and follow the compare-and-set loop when another update wins the race.
challenge.results: After a failed comparison, the implementation rereads the current value and invokes the update function again. Atomicity concerns the committed atom replacement. Callback side effects are outside that guarantee.

limitations: Pinned JVM atom API. Validation, watches and the behavior of unrelated references have separate rules.
